title: When two templated upstreams in temporal-proxy render the same address, a request routed to one upstream can be sent…
description: A vulnerability in temporal-proxy versions 0.1.0 through 1.1.1 allows requests routed to one templated upstream to be sent using another upstream's credentials and encryption keys if both render the same address. This occurs because temporal-proxy pools connections by rendered address and TLS server name only, mixing traffic between upstreams with different credentials. Deployments with only one templated upstream are not affected. The issue is fixed in versions 1.0.2, 1.1.2, and 1.2.0.
